permissions.chatmod.modinfo: Allows access to the base /chatmod help command.
permissions.chatmod.name.modify: Allows modifying info files via /<name> subcommands.
permissions.chatmod.bc.now: Allows sending/scheduling ad-hoc broadcasts (global and single-player).
permissions.chatmod.internal.display: Allows display of info file content via actions (internal).
permissions.chatmod.items: Allows viewing predefined items via /chatmod items (GUI and list).
permissions.chatmod.items.edit: Allows managing predefined items via /chatmod items (GUI and commands).
permissions.chatmod.items.format: Allows customizing the chat name prefix/suffix via /chatmod items format.
permissions.chatmod.chatitem: Allows a player to use the [item] placeholder to display their held item in chat.
permissions.chatmod.chatitem.number: Allows a player to use the [item:#] placeholder to display predefined items.
permissions.chatmod.chatitem.icon: Allows a player to use the [#item] / [#item:#] placeholder to display an atlas-sprite icon + item name.
permissions.chatmod.chatitem.icon_only: Allows a player to use the [##item] / [##item:#] placeholder to display only the atlas-sprite icon (no name).
permissions.chatmod.chaticon: Allows a player to use [#SpriteName] in chat to display any atlas-sprite icon (e.g. [#diamond], [#custom/star]).
permissions.chatmod.chat.color: Allows a player to use colour codes in chat: &0-9, &a-f, &#RRGGBB hex.
permissions.chatmod.chat.format: Allows a player to use formatting codes in chat: &l (bold), &o (italic), &n (underline), &m (strikethrough), &k (obfuscated), &r (reset).
permissions.chatmod.chatcolor.self: Allows a player to set their own persistent chat colour via /cm chatcolor.
permissions.chatmod.chatcolor.others: Allows setting another player's persistent chat colour via /cm chatcolor <code> <player>.
permissions.chatmod.chatcolor.black: Allows using black (&0) as a persistent chat colour.
permissions.chatmod.chatcolor.dark_blue: Allows using dark blue (&1) as a persistent chat colour.
permissions.chatmod.chatcolor.dark_green: Allows using dark green (&2) as a persistent chat colour.
permissions.chatmod.chatcolor.dark_aqua: Allows using dark aqua (&3) as a persistent chat colour.
permissions.chatmod.chatcolor.dark_red: Allows using dark red (&4) as a persistent chat colour.
permissions.chatmod.chatcolor.dark_purple: Allows using dark purple (&5) as a persistent chat colour.
permissions.chatmod.chatcolor.gold: Allows using gold (&6) as a persistent chat colour.
permissions.chatmod.chatcolor.gray: Allows using gray (&7) as a persistent chat colour.
permissions.chatmod.chatcolor.dark_gray: Allows using dark gray (&8) as a persistent chat colour.
permissions.chatmod.chatcolor.blue: Allows using blue (&9) as a persistent chat colour.
permissions.chatmod.chatcolor.green: Allows using green (&a) as a persistent chat colour.
permissions.chatmod.chatcolor.aqua: Allows using aqua (&b) as a persistent chat colour.
permissions.chatmod.chatcolor.red: Allows using red (&c) as a persistent chat colour.
permissions.chatmod.chatcolor.light_purple: Allows using light purple (&d) as a persistent chat colour.
permissions.chatmod.chatcolor.yellow: Allows using yellow (&e) as a persistent chat colour.
permissions.chatmod.chatcolor.white: Allows using white (&f) as a persistent chat colour.
permissions.chatmod.chatcolor.RRGGBB: Template permission for hex colours — replace RRGGBB with the 6 lowercase hex digits, e.g. chatmod.chatcolor.ff5500. Requires chatmod.chatcolor.self.
permissions.chatmod.chatcolors: Grants permission to use ALL colour codes (named and hex) as a persistent chat colour. Shortcut wildcard — no need to grant individual colour nodes.
permissions.chatmod.chatcolor.sprites: Grants permission to use ANY atlas sprite (e.g. [#dirt], [#diamond], [#playerhead]) as a persistent chat colour prefix. Requires chatmod.chatcolor.self.
permissions.chatmod.chatcolor.sprite.player: Grants permission to use [#playerhead] (own player head) as a persistent chat colour prefix via /cm chatcolor player.
permissions.chatmod.chatcolor.sprite.<name>: Template: grants permission for a specific sprite prefix, e.g. chatmod.chatcolor.sprite.dirt for [#dirt]. Requires chatmod.chatcolor.self.
permissions.chatmod.player.tag: Allows tagging individual players using @PlayerName or PlayerName@.
permissions.chatmod.player.tag.everyone: Allows tagging @everyone (or everyone@) to notify all online players.
permissions.chatmod.broadcast.<name>: Example permission for a specific predefined broadcast: chatmod.broadcast.event_soon
permissions.chatmod.info.<name>: Example permission for a specific info command: chatmod.info.rules
